headline: BAL @ SEA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 4.13 at SEA 4.18, with a projected total of 8.31. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: BAL moved +0.61 runs while SEA moved +0.04, changing the projected margin by +0.57 runs. The projected total climbed +0.65, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Brandon Young has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Cole Young, Jhonny Pereda, Pete Alonso, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Luke Raley because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
